name: SegmentedControl
purpose: Lets users switch between a small, fixed set of mutually exclusive modes or views, with no associated content panel.
neverUseFor: Navigating between real pages or routes — use NavItem/Tab instead
Content that switches inside an associated panel — that's a tabs pattern (tablist/tab), not this
More than ~5 options, or options with long labels — use RadioGroup or Select instead
rationale: SegmentedControl is a hand-rolled radiogroup with roving tabindex (ADR-012) because no native element renders a segmented button set. It has one fixed size, semantic.size.s (24px), and switches modes with no associated panel — that's the line that separates it from tabs.

mayExtendLocally: Choose up to ~5 short options and the selected value
Use icons inside options per usage
mustEscalateToDS: Adding sizes or more than ~5 options
Using it for routing or tab panels
Changing the keyboard model or indicator motion

authored.name: disabled
authored.description: The whole control, or an individual option, is non-interactive.
authored.aria: disabled (native HTML attribute) on the option's button

anatomy.description: The sliding highlight behind the checked option. Purely decorative — `aria-hidden`.
Optional icon of an icon-only option, rendered through Icon (decorative — the option's label is its accessible name). Takes the label's default/checked/hover colors.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the group (`aria-label` on the root — this control has no visible legend).

props.name: options
props.description: The list of choices. Each option: { value, label, icon?, disabled? }. With `icon` (a Tabler icon component, rendered through Icon) the option is icon-only: `label` stays as its accessible name (visually hidden).

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every option in the group.

props.name: name
props.description: Native form field name, submitted via a hidden input mirroring the selected value. Auto-generated if omitted.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional className for the root element.

height.note: semantic.size.s — one rung below Button's default height/Input's default field height on the same shared scale. No size prop; this control has one fixed size.

a11y.role: radiogroup (hand-rolled — root is a plain div, options are buttons, not native inputs; see ADR-012)
keyboardNav: Arrow keys — move selection between options (roving tabindex, hand-rolled)
Tab — moves focus into and out of the group (only the checked option is in the tab order)

motion: CSS transitions/animations: neutralised by the global prefers-reduced-motion rule

properties.name: checked
properties.description: On SegmentedControlItem: the option whose value equals the group's `value`. Checked = the pill (fill/page) — in code a sliding motion.span.

figma.structure: SegmentedControlItem set (checked × state) composed into SegmentedControl (state default/disabled): track fill/secondary/interactive/default (fill/disabled when disabled),   4px padding and gap,   radius full.

label.reason: the group's aria-label — never drawn; the visible text is each item's own label (segmented-control-item-label)

figma.variantCombinations: 12 variants (2026-10-21): options (2–7 SegmentedControlItem instances, the first checked; list-count) × disabled false/true,  no state axis (pattern group). label is the aria-label: no Figma property.

KeyboardNavigation.reason: keyboard focus — the focus ring is drawn in Figma (owner 2026-10-21: focus states are drawn)
